title: Bristol Mountain Ski Resort
specs: 97% of trails lit for night skiing
Children under 48" tall must be accompanied by an adult 18 or older on chairlift
Children ages two and younger must be secured in a car seat or child carrier on chairlift; parents must provide their own carrier
Participants must have a valid ticket for Climb to the Summit Series event day (lift ticket, season pass, or Nordic Trail Ticket)
Freestyle terrain requires skill and familiarity; inverted aerials not permitted
Group rates available for groups of 15 or more
One complimentary lift ticket earned for every 15 paid group admissions

blurb: Bristol Mountain offers skiing and snowboarding on 39 slopes and trails with a 1,200' vertical and 2 high-speed quads. The resort provides night skiing with lighting on 97% of trails during the night season. They host events such as the Blue Suspenders Expedition and Climb to the Summit Series.
